company.name: Amazon India
company.about: Amazon is guided by four principles: customer obsession rather than competitor focus, passion for invention, commitment to operational excellence, and long-term thinking.

title: Amazon Campus Recruitment 2026
description: Recruiting Software Development Engineers (SDE-I) for AWS, Prime Video, and Core Retail engineering organizations. Candidates should have strong algorithms and problem solving abilities.

rounds.name: Online Assessment (OA)
rounds.details: 2 Coding questions (Data Structures & Algorithms) + 20 MCQs on OS, DBMS, Networks, and Amazon Leadership Principles.

rounds.name: Technical Interview Round I
rounds.details: Problem solving and coding live on shared editor. Deep dive into Trees, Graphs, and HashMaps with complexity optimization.

rounds.name: Technical Interview Round II & LLD
rounds.details: Low Level System Design (Object Oriented Design patterns) + review of undergraduate projects and database schemas.

rounds.name: Bar Raiser & Leadership Discussion
rounds.details: In-depth behavioral interview evaluating Amazon's 16 Leadership Principles with concrete past project examples.
